description: Single authoritative record of CI tool versions and the mechanism that verifies each download. Tools are split by acquisition method because the verification story differs: `checksummed_download` tools are fetched by .github/actions/install-checksummed-tool and MUST carry a real publisher-backed SHA-256; `pinned_action` tools are installed by a first-party action pinned to a full commit SHA, which performs its own checksum and signature verification, so no hash is recorded here.
notes: Schema v1 of this file contained two fabricated SHA-256 values: tflint's was 60 characters and contained non-hex letters (a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8...), and sonar_scanner's was 61 characters. Neither could ever have matched a real artifact. It also recorded sonar_scanner 6.1.0.4547 while both workflows downloaded 5.0.1.3006 by unverified wget, and described postgres:16.4-bookworm as a 'pin_digest' when it is a tag.

Rather than invent replacement hashes, tflint and the Sonar scanner now install via pinned first-party actions that verify their own downloads. That is stronger than a hand-copied hash and removes the drift surface.

OUTSTANDING: the four checksums below were inherited and have NOT been re-verified against the publishers' checksum files in this change. Verify each against the corresponding release's checksums file before treating them as trusted, and record the verification date here.

actionlint.description: GitHub Actions workflow schema and expression validation

gitleaks.description: Secret scanning over full git history

trivy.description: Container image and IaC configuration scanner

tflint.description: Terraform linter. The first-party action verifies the release checksum and GPG signature.

terraform.description: Terraform CLI, static use only (fmt / init -backend=false / validate).

sonar_scanner.description: SonarCloud scanner. The action pins and verifies its own scanner download; the token is passed via the environment, never on the command line.

python.description: Must agree with backend/pyproject.toml requires-python, [tool.ruff] target-version, backend/Dockerfile, and sonar.python.version.

node.description: Must agree with frontend/package.json engines.node and frontend/Dockerfile.

postgresql.description: CI service container, pinned to a patch-level tag. A digest pin is stronger and remains the target; this is not a digest and must not be described as one.

playwright.description: Must be an exact version in frontend/package.json; the browser revision is derived from the installed package.
